input_messages.content:
Hi! I actually need help with a couple of things. I recently moved to a new house, but it’s still on Elm Avenue here in Houston. I noticed that one of my recent orders was sent to my old address instead of the new one, and I’d like to get that fixed. Also, can you update my default address in your system to the new house? I’d prefer not to share my address again since it should be in my order history. 

And one more thing—I’d like to exchange the tablet I ordered for the cheapest model you have, since moving has been expensive. Can you help me with all of this?

Sure! My name is Sophia Martin and my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to pull up my orders—I’d really prefer not to share my address or zip code if possible, since you should be able to see my recent orders and addresses on file.

Thanks for checking my order details! I’d really prefer not to provide my new address directly—since you can see both my old and new addresses in my recent orders, could you please just update the shipping address for this order and set my default address to the new one that’s already in your system? I want to make sure everything goes to the right place from now on.

And yes, I want to exchange the tablet from this order (#W1603792) for the cheapest tablet you have available. Please let me know what my options are!

Thank you for updating my address and default info!

Yes, please go ahead and exchange my current tablet (the 7-inch, 32GB, gold one) for the cheapest option—the 10-inch, 64GB, silver tablet for $903.95. I’d like any refund from the price difference to go back to my Mastercard ending in 3292, just like my original order.

Let me know if you need anything else from me to process the exchange!
Yes, that’s correct! Please proceed with the exchange and refund the difference to my Mastercard ending in 3292. Thanks for your help!

That’s perfect, thank you so much for your help! Everything is all set now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
